verses: Aey eman walo! ehad o ehad-o-paymaan pooray kero, tumharay liye maweshi chopaye halal kiye gaye hain ba-juz unn kay jin kay naam parh ker suna diye jayen gay magar halat ehraam mein shikar ko halal jannay walay na banna, yaqeenan Allah jo chahaye hukum kerta hai

Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa kay shaaeer ki bey hurmati na kero na adab walay maheenon ki na haram mein qurban honey walay aur pattay pehnaye gaye janwaron ki jo kaaba ko jaa rahey hun aur na unn logon ki jo bait Allah kay qasad say apney rab Taalaa kay fazal aur uss ki raza ki niyat say jaa rahey hun, haan jab tum ehraam utaar dalo to shikar khel saktay ho, jin logon ney tumhen masjid haram say roka tha unn ki dushmani tumhen uss baat per aamaadah na keray kay tum hadd say guzar jao, neki aur perhezgari mein aik doosray ki imdad kertay raho aur gunah aur zulm o ziyadti mein madad na kero, aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raho, be-shak Allah Taalaa sakht saza denay wala hai

Tum per haram kiya gaya murdaar aur khoon aur khinzeer ka gosht aur jiss per Allah kay siwa doosray ka naam pukara gaya ho aur jo gala ghutney say marra ho aur jo kissi zarab say marr gaya ho aur jo unchi jagah say gir ker marra ho aur jo kissi kay seeng maarney say marra ho aur jissay darindon ney phaar khaya ho lekin ussay tum zibah ker dalo to haram nahi aur jo aastanon per zibah kiya gaya ho aur yeh bhi kay quraa kay teeron kay zariye faal geeri kero yeh sab bad-tareen gunah hain, aaj kuffaar tumharay deen say na-umeed hogaye, khabardaar! tum unn say na darna aur mujh say dartay rehna, aaj mein ney tumharay liye deen ko kamil kerdiya aur tum per apna inam bharpoor kerdiya aur tumharay liye islam kay deen honey per mand hogaya. Pus jo shakhs shiddat ki bhook mein bey qarar ho jaye ba-shart-e-kay kissi gunah ki taraf uss ka meelaan na ho to yaqeenan Allah Taalaa moaf kerney wala aur boht bara meharban hai

Aap say daryaft kertay hain kay unn kay liye kiya kuch halal hai? Aap keh dijiye kay tamam pak cheezen tumharay liye halal ki gaee hain, aur jin shikar khelney walay janwaron ko tum ney sidha rakha hai yani jinhen tum thora boht woh sikhatay ho jiss ki taleem Allah Taalaa ney tumhen dey rakhi hai pus jiss shikar ko woh tumharay liye pakar ker rok rakhen to tum uss say kha lo aur uss per Allah Taalaa kay naam ka zikar ker liya kero. Aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raho, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa jald hisab lenay wala hai

Kul pakeezah cheezen aaj tumharay liye halal ki gaeen aur ahl kitab ka zabeeha tumharay liye halal hai aur tumhara zabeeha unn kay liye halal hai, aur pak daman musalman aurten aur jo log tum say pehlay kitab diye gaye hain unn ki pak daman aurten bhi halal hain jab kay tum unn kay mehar ada kero, uss tarah kay tum unn say ba-qaeeda nikkah kero yeh nahi kay aelaaniya zinna kero ya posheedah bad-kaari kero, munkireen eman kay aemaal zaya aur ikaarat hain aur aakhirat mein woh haarney walon mein say hain

Aey eman walo! jab tum namaz kay liye utho to apney mun ko, aur apney hathon ko kohniyon samet dho lo apney saron ka masah kero aur apney paon ko takhnon samet dho lo, aur agar tum janabat ki halat mein ho to ghusul kerlo, haan agar tum beemar ho ya safar ki halat mein ho ya tum mein say koi hajat zaroori say farigh ho ker aaya ho, ya tum aurton say milay ho aur tumhen pani na milay to tum pak mitti say tayammum kerlo, ussay apney chehron per aur hathon per mill lo Allah Taalaa tum per kissi qasam ki tangi daalna nahi chahata balkay)yeh uss ka iradah tumhen pak kerney ka aur tumhen apni bharpoor nemat denay ka hai, takay tum shukar ada kertay raho

Tum per Allah Taalaa ki jo nematen nazil hui hain unhen yaad rakho aur uss kay uss ehad ko bhi jiss ka tum say mohaeeda hua hai jabkay tum ney kaha hum ney suna aur mana aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raho, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa dilon ki baaton ka jannay wala hai

Aey eman walo! tum Allah ki khatir haq per qaeem ho jao, raasti aur insaf kay sath gawahi denay walay bann jao, kissi qom ki adawat tumhen khilaf adal per aamaadah na kerdey, adal kiya kero jo perhez gaari kay ziyadah qareeb hai, aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raho, yaqeen mano kay Allah Taalaa tumharay aemaal say ba-khabar hai
Allah Taalaa ka wada hai kay jo eman layen aur nek kaam keren unn kay liye wasee maghfirat aur boht bara ajar o sawab hai
Aur jin logon ney kufur kiya aur humaray ehkaam ko jhutlaya woh dozakhi hain

Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa ney jo ehsan tum per kiya hai ussay yaad kero jab kay aik qom ney tum per dast darazi kerni chahai to Allah Taalaa ney unn kay hathon ko tum tak phonchney say rok diya aur Allah Taalaa say dartay raho aur mominon ko Allah Taalaa hi per bharosa kerna chahaiye

Aur Allah Taalaa ney bani israeel say ehad o paymaan liya aur unhi mein say baara sardar hum ney muqarrar farmaye aur Allah Taalaa ney farma diya kay yaqeenan mein tumharay sath hun, agar tum namaz qaeem rakho gay aur zakat detay raho gay aur meray rasoolon ko mantay raho gay aur unn ki madad kertay raho gay aur Allah Taalaa ko behtar qarz detay raho gay to yaqeenan mein tumhari buraiyan tum say door rakhoon ga aur tumhen unn jannaton mein ley jaon ga jin kay neechay chashmay beh rahey hain, abb uss ehad o-paymaan kay baad bhi tum mein say jo inkari ho jaye woh yaqeenan raah raast say bhatak gaya

Phir unn ki ehad shikni ki wajah say hum ney unn per apni laanat nazil farma aur unn kay dil sakht kerdiye kay woh kalaam ko uss ki jagah say badal daaltay hain aur jo kuch naseehat unhen ki gaee thi uss ka boht bara hissa bhala bethay, unn ki aik na aik khayanat per tujhay itlaa milti hi rahey gi haan thoray say aisay nahi bhi hain pus unhen moaf kerta jaa aur darguzar kerta reh, be-shak Allah Taalaa ehsan kerney walon say mohabbat kerta hai

Aur jo apney aap ko nasrani kehtay hain hum ney unn say bhi ehad o-paymaan liya, unhon ney bhi uss ka bara hissa faramosh ker diya jo unhen naseehat ki gaee thi, to hum ney bhi unn kay aapas mein bughz o adawat daal di jo ta-qayamat rahey gi aur jo kuch yeh kertay thay unqareeb Allah Taalaa unhen sab bata dey ga

Aey ahl kitab! yaqeenan tumharay pass humara rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) chuka jo tumharay samney kitab Allah ki ba-kasrat aisi baaten zahir ker raha hai jinhen tum chupa rahey thay aur boht si baaton say darguzar kerta hai, tumharay pass Allah Taalaa ki taraf say noor aur wazeh kitab chuki hai

Jiss kay zariye say Allah Taalaa unhen jo raza-e rab kay darpay hun salamti ki raahen batlata hai aur apni tofiq say andheron say nikal ker noor ki taraf laata hai aur raah raast ki taraf unn ki rehbari kerta hai

Yaqeenan woh log kafir hogaye jinhon ney kaha kay Allah hi maseeh ibn Maryam hai, aap unn say keh dijiye kay agar Allah Taalaa maseeh ibn Maryam aur uss ki walida aur aur zamin kay sab logon ko halak ker dena chahaye to kaun hai jo Allah Taalaa per kuch bhi ikhtiyar rakhta ho? Aasmano o zamin aur dono kay darmiyan ka kul mulk Allah Taalaa hi ka hai, woh jo chahata hai peda kerta hai, aur Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai

Yahud o nasaara kehtay hain kay hum Allah kay betay aur uss kay dost hain, aap keh dijiye kay phir tumhen tumharay gunahon kay baees Allah kiyon saza deta hai? Nahi balkay)yeh tum bhi uss ki makhlooq mein say aik insan ho woh jissay chahata hai bakhsh deta hai, aur jissay chahata hai azab kerta hai, zamin o aasman aur unn kay darmiyan ki her cheez Allah Taalaa ki milkiyat hai aur ussi ki taraf lotna hai

Aey ahl kitab! bil-yaqeen humara rasool tumharay pass rasoolon ki aamad kay aik waqfay kay baad aa phoncha hai. Jo tumharay liye saaf saaf biyan ker raha hai takay tumhari yeh baat na reh jaye kay humaray pass to koi bhalaee, buraee sunaney wala aaya hi nahi, pus abb to yaqeenan khushkhabri sunaney wala aur aagah kerney wala aa phoncha aur Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai

Aur yaad kero Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney apni qom say kaha, aey meri qom kay logo! Allah Taalaa kay uss ehsan ka zikar kero kay uss ney tum mein say payghumbar banaye aur tumhen badshah bana diya aur tumhen woh diya jo tamam aalam mein kissi ko nahi diya
Aey meri qom walo! uss muqaddas zamin mein dakhil ho jao jo Allah Taalaa ney tumharay naam likh di hai aur apni pusht kay bal roo-gardani na kero kay phir nuksan mein jaa paro

Unhon ney jawab diya kay aey Musa o haan to zor aawar sirkash log hain aur jab tak woh o haan say nikal na jayen hum to hergiz o haan na jayen gay haan agar woh o haan say nikal jayen phir to hum (ba-khushi) chalay jayen gay

Do shakhson ney jo khuda taras logon mein say thay, jin per Allah Taalaa ka fazal tha kaha kay tum unn kay pass darwazay mein to phonch jao, darwazay mein qadam rakhtay hi yaqeenan tum ghalib aajao gay, aur tum agar momin ho to tumhen Allah Taalaa hi per bharosa rakhna chahaye
Qom ney jawab diya kay aey Musa! jab tak woh o haan hain tab tak hum hergiz o haan na jayen gay, uss liye tum aur tumhara perwerdigar jaa ker dono hi larr bhirr lo, hum yahin bethay huye hain
Musa (alaihi as-salam) kehney lagay elahi! mujhay to ba-juz apney aur meray bhai kay kissi aur per koi ikhtiyar nahi, pus to hum mein aur unn na-farmano mein judaee kerdey
Irshad hua kay abb zamin unn per chalees saal tak haram ker di gaee hai, yeh khana badosh udhar udhar sir-gardan phirtay rahen gay uss liye tum unn fasiqon kay baray mein ghumgeen na hona

Adam (alaihi as-salam) kay dono beton ka khara khara haal bhi unhen suna do, unn dono ney aik nazrana paish kiya, unn mein say aik ki nazar to qabool hogaee aur doosray ki maqbool na hui to woh kehney laga kay mein tujhay maar hi dalon ga, uss ney kaha Allah Taalaa taqwa walon ka hi amal qabool kerta hai
Go to meray qatal kay liye dast darazi keray lekin mein teray qatal ki taraf hergiz apney hath na barhaon ga, mein to Allah Taalaa perwerdigar aalam say khof khata hun
Mein to chahata hun kay to mera gunah aur apney gunah apney sir per rakh ley aur dozakhiyon mein shamil hojaye, zalimon ka yehi badla hai
Pus ussay uss kay nafs ney apney bhai kay qatal per aamaadah ker diya aur uss ney ussay qatal ker dala, jiss say nuksan paney walon mein say hogaya

Phir Allah Taalaa ney aik kawway ko bheja jo zamin khod raha tha takay ussay dikhaye kay woh kiss tarah apney bhai ki naash ko chupa dey, woh kehney laga, haaye afsos! kiya mein aisa kerney say bhi gaya guzra hogaya kay uss kawway ki tarah apney bhai ki laash ko dafna deta? Phir to (bara hi) pashemaan aur sharminda hogaya

Ussi wajah say hum ney bani israeel per yeh likh diya kay jo shakhs kissi ko baghair uss kay kay woh kissi ka qatil ho ya zamin mein fasad machaney wala ho, qatal ker dalay to goya uss ney tamam logon ko qatal kerdiya, aur jo shakhs kissi aik ki jaan bacha ley, uss ney goya tamam logon ko zindah kerdiya aur unn kay pass humaray boht say rasool zahir daleelen ley ker aaye lekin phir uss kay baad bhi unn mein kay aksar log zamin mein zulm o ziyadti aur zabardasti kerney walay hi rahey

Jo Allah Taalaa say aur uss kay rasool say laren aur zamin mein fasad kertay phiren unn ki saza yehi hai kay woh qatal ker diye jayen ya sooli charha diye jayen ya mukhalif janib say unn kay hath paaon kaat diye jayen, ya unhen jila-watan ker diya jaye, yeh to hui unn ki dunyawi zillat aur khuwari, aur aakhirat mein unn kay liye bara bhari azab hai
Haan jo log uss say pehlay tauba ker len kay tum unn per qaboo paalo to yaqeen mano kay Allah Taalaa boht bari bakhsish aur reham o karam wala hai
Musalmano! Allah Taalaa say dartay raho aur uss ka qurb talash kero aur uss ki raah mein jihad kero takay tumhara bhala ho

Yaqeen mano kay kafiron kay liye agar woh sab kuch ho jo sari zamin mein hai balkay)yeh ussi kay misil aur bhi ho aur woh uss sab ko qayamat kay din kay azab kay badlay fidye mein dena chahayen to bhi na-mumkin hai kay unn ka fidya qabool kerliya jaye, unn kay liye to dard naak azab hi hai
Yeh chahayen gay kay dozakh mein say nikal jayen lekin yeh hergiz uss mein say na nikal saken gay, unn kay liye to dawami azab hain
Chori kerney walay mard aur aurat kay hath kaat diya kero. Yeh badla hai uss ka jo unhon ney kiya. Azab, Allah ki taraf say aur Allah Taalaa qooat o hikmat wala hai
Jo shakhs apney gunah kay baad tauba kerley aur islaah kerley to Allah Taalaa rehmat kay sath uss ki taraf lot’ta hai. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa moaf farmaney wala meharbani kerney wala hai
Kiya tujhay maloom nahi kay Allah Taalaa hi kay liye zamin o aasman ki badshahat hai? Jissay chahaye saza dey aur jissay chahaye moaf kerdey, Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai

Aey rasool! aap unn logon kay peechay na kurhiye jo kufur mein sabqat ker rahey hain khuwah woh unn (munafiqon) mein say hun jo zabani to eman ka dawa kertay hain lekin haqeeqatan unn kay dil ba-emaan nahi aur yahudiyon mein say kuch log aisay hain jo ghalat baaten sunnay kay aadi hain aur unn logon kay jasoos hain jo abb tak aap kay pass nahi aaye, woh kalmaat kay asli moqa ko chor ker unhen mutaghayyur kerdiya kertay hain, kehtay hain kay agar tum yehi hukum diye jao to qabool ker lena aur agar yeh hukum na diye jao to alag thalag rehna aur jiss ka kharab kerna Allah ko manzoor ho to aap uss kay liye khudaee hidayat mein say kissi cheez kay mukhtar nahi. Allah Taalaa ka iradah unn kay dilon ko pak kerney ka nahi, unn kay liye duniya mein bhi bari zillat aur ruswaee hai aur aakhirat mein bhi unn kay liye bari sakht saza hai

Yeh kaan laga laga ker jhoot kay sunnay walay aur ji bhar bhar ker haram kay khaney walay hain, agar yeh tumharay pass aayen to tumhen ikhtiyar hai khuwah unn kay aapas ka faisla kero khuwah unn ko taal do, agar tum unn say mun bhi phero gay to bhi yeh tum ko hergiz koi zarar nahi phoncha saktay, aur agar tum faisla kero to unn mein adal o insaf kay sath faisla kero, yaqeenan adal walon kay sath Allah mohabbat rakhta hai

(tajjub ki baat hai kay) woh kaisay apney pass Taurat hotay huye jiss mein ehkaam elahi hain tum ko munsif banatay hain phir uss kay baad bhi phir jatay hain, dar-asal yeh eman o yaqeen walay hain hi nahi

Hum ney Taurat nazil farmaee hai jiss mein hidayat o noor hai, yahudiyon mein ussi Taurat kay sath Allah Taalaa kay mannay walay anbiya (alaihim as-salam) aur ahl Allah aur ulama faislay kertay thay kyunkay unhen Allah ki uss kitab ki hifazat ka hukum diya gaya tha. Aur woh uss per iqrari gawah thay abb tumhen chahaye kay logon say na daro aur sirf mera darr rakho, meri aayaton ko thoray thoray mol per na becho, jo log Allah ki utari hui wahee kay sath faislay na keren woh (pooray aur pukhta) kafir hain

Aur hum ney yahudiyon kay zimmay Taurat mein yeh baat muqarrar ker di thi kay jaan kay badlay jaan aur aankh kay badlay aankh aur naak kay badlay naak aur kaan kay badlay kaan aur daant kay badlay daant aur khaas zakhmon ka bhi badla hai, phir jo shakhs uss ko moaf kerdey to woh uss kay liye kaffaara hai, aur jo log Allah kay nazil kiye huye kay mutabiq hukum na keren, o hi log zalim hain

Aur hum ney unn kay peechay Isa bann Maryam ko bheja jo apney say pehlay ki kitab yani Taurat ki tasdeeq kerney walay thay aur hum ney unhen Injeel ata farmaee jiss mein noor aur hidayat thi aur woh apney say pehlay ki kitab Taurat ki tasdeeq kerti thi aur woh sirasir hidayat o naseehat thi paarsa logon kay liye

Aur Injeel walon ko bhi chahaiye kay Allah Taalaa ney jo kuch Injeel mein nazil farmaya hai ussi kay mutabiq hukum keren aur jo Allah Taalaa kay nazil kerdah say hi hukum na keren woh (badkaar) fasiq hain

Aur hum ney aap ki taraf haq kay sath yeh kitab nazil farmaee hai jo apney say agli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerney wali hai aur unn ki mohafiz hai. Uss liye aap unn kay aapas kay moamlaat mein ussi Allah ki utari hui kitab kay sath hukum kijiye, uss haq say hatt ker unn ki khuwaishon kay peechay na jaiye tum mein say her aik kay liye hum ney aik dastoor aur raah muqarrar kerdi hai. Agar manzoor maula hota to tum sab ko aik hi ummat bana deta, lekin uss ki chahat hai kay jo tumhen diya hai uss mein tumhen aazmaye, tum nekiyon ki taraf jaldi kero, tum sab ka rujoo Allah hi ki taraf hai, phir woh tumhen her woh cheez bata dey ga jiss mein tum ikhtilaf kertay rehtay ho

Aap unn kay moamlaat mein khuda ki nazil kerdah wahee kay mutabiq hi hukum kiya kijiye, unn ki khuwaishon ki tabeydaari na kijiye aur unn say hoshiyaar rahiye kay kahen yeh aap ko Allah kay utaray huye kissi hukum say udhar udhar na keren, agar yeh log mun pher len to yaqeen keren kay Allah ka iradah yehi hai kay unhen unn kay baaz gunahon ki saza dey hi dalay aur aksar log na farman hi hotay hain
Kiya yeh log phir say jaheeliyat ka faisla chahatay hain yaqeen rakhney walay logon kay liye Allah Taalaa say behtar faislay aur hukum kerney wala kaun hosakta hai?

Aey eman walo! tum yahud o nasaara ko dost na banao yeh to aapas mein hi aik doosray kay dost hain. Tum mein say jo bhi unn mein kissi say dosti keray woh be-shak unhi mein say hai, zalimon ko Allah Taalaa hergiz raah raast nahi dikhata

Aap dekhen gay kay jin kay dilon mein beemari hai woh dor dor ker unn mein ghuss rahey hain aur kehtay hain kay humen khatra hai, aisa na ho kay koi haadsa hum per parr jaye boht mumkin hai kay Allah Taalaa fatah dey dey. Ya apney pass say koi aur cheez laye phir to yeh apney dilon mein chupaee hui baaton per (bey tarah) naadim honey lagen gay
Aur eman walay kahen gay, kiya yehi woh log hain jo baray mubalighay say Allah ki qasmen kha kha ker kehtay hain kay hum tumharay sath hain. Unn kay aemaal ghaarat huye aur yeh nakaam hogaye

Aey eman walo! tum mein say jo shakhs apney deen say phir jaye to Allah Taalaa boht jald aisi qom ko laye ga jo Allah ki mehboob hogi aur woh bhi Allah say mohabbat rakhti hogi woh naram dil hun gay musalmanon per aur sakht aur tez hun gay kuffaar per, Allah ki raah mein jihad keren gay aur kissi malamat kerney walay ki malamat ki perwah bhi na keren gay, yeh hai Allah Taalaa ka fazal jissay chahaye dey, Allah Taalaa bari wusat wala aur zabardast ilm wala hai
(musalmano)! tumhara dost khud Allah hai aur uss ka rasool hai aur eman walay hain jo namazon ki pabandi kertay hain aur zakat ada kertay hain aur woh rukoo (khushoo o khuzoo) kerney walay hain
Aur jo shakhs Allah Taalaa say aur uss kay rasool say aur musalmanon say dosti keray, woh yaqeen manay kay Allah Taalaa ki jamat hi ghalib rahey gi

Musalmano! unn logon ko dost na banao jo tumharay deen ko hansi khel banaye huye hain (khuwah) woh unn mein say hun jo tum say pehlay kitab diye gaye ya kuffaar hun agar tum momin ho to Allah Taalaa say dartay raho.
Aur jab tum namaz kay liye pukartay ho to woh ussay hansi khel thehra letay hain. Yeh uss wastay kay aqal hain

Aap keh dijiye aey yahudiyon aur nasraniyo! tum hum say sirf uss wajah say dusmaniyan ker rahey ho kay hum Allah Taalaa per aur jo kuch humari janib nazil kiya gaya hai aur jo kuch uss say pehlay utara gaya hai uss per eman laye hain aur uss liye bhi kay tum mein aksar fasiq hain

Keh dijiye kay kiya mein tumhen bataon? Kay uss say bhi ziyadah buray ajar paney wala Allah Taalaa kay nazdeek kaun hai? Woh jiss per Allah Taalaa ney laanat ki aur uss per woh ghussa hua aur unn mein say baaz ko bandar aur sooar bana diya aur jinhon ney maboodaan baatil ki parastish ki, yehi log badtar darjay walay hain aur yehi raah raast say boht ziyadah bhatakney walay hain

Aur jab tumharay pass aatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum eman laye halankay woh kufur liye huye hi aaye thay aur ussi kufur kay sath hi gaye bhi aur yeh jo kuch chupa rahey hain ussay Allah Taalaa khoob janta hai
Aap dekhen gay kay unn mein say aksar gunah kay kaamon ki taraf aur zulm o ziyadti ki taraf aur maal haram khaney ki taraf lapak rahey hain, jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain woh nihayat buray kaam hain
Unhen unn kay abid o aalam jhoot baaton kay kehney aur haram cheezon kay khaney say kiyon nahi roktay, be-shak bura kaam hai jo yeh ker rahey hain

Aur yahudiyon ney kaha kay Allah Taalaa kay hath bandhay huye hain. Unhi kay hath bandhay huye hain aur unn kay uss qol ki wajah say unn per laanat ki gaee, balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa kay dono hath khulay huye hain. Jiss tarah chahata hai kharach kerta hai aur jo kuch teri taraf teray rab ki janib say utara jata hai woh unn mein say aksar ko to sirkashi aur kufur mein aur barha deta hai aur hum ney unn mein aapas mein hi qayamat tak kay liye adawat aur bughz daal diya hai, woh jab kabhi laraee ki aag ko bharkana chahatay hain to Allah Taalaa ussay bujha deta hai, yeh mulk bhar mein shar o fasad machatay phirtay hain aur Allah Taalaa fasadiyon say mohabbat nahi kerta
Aur agar yeh ahl kitab eman latay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to hum unn ki tamam buraiyan moaf farma detay aur zaroor unhen rahat o aaram ki jannaton mein ley jatay

Aur agar yeh log Taurat o Injeel aur unn ki janib jo kuch Allah Taalaa ki taraf say nazil farmaya gaya hai, unn kay pooray paband rehtay to yeh log apney upper say aur neechay say roziyan patay aur khatay, aik jamat to unn mein say darmiyana ravish ki hai, baqi unn mein say boht say logon kay buray aemaal hain

Aey rasool jo kuch bhi aap ki taraf aap kay rab ki janib say nazil kiya gaya hai phoncha dijiye. Agar aap ney aisa na kiya to aap ney Allah ki risalat ada nahi ki, aur aap ko Allah Taalaa logon say bacha ley ga be-shak Allah Taalaa kafir logon ko hidayat nahi deta

Aap keh dijiye kay aey ahl kitab! tum dar-asal kissi cheez per nahi jab tak kay Taurat o Injeel ko aur jo kuch tumhari taraf tumharay rab ki say taraf utara gaya hai qaeem na kero, jo kuch aap ki janib aap kay rab ki taraf say itra hai woh unn mein say bohton ko shararat aur inkar mein aur bhi barhaye ga hi, to aap unn kafiron per ghumgeen na hun
Musalman, yahudi, sitara parast aur nasrani koi ho, jo bhi Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman laye aur nek amal keray woh mehaz khof rahey ga aur bilkul bey ghum hojaye ga

Hum ney bil-yaqeen israeel say ehad o-paymaan liya aur unn ki taraf rasoolon ko bheja, jab kabhi rasool unn kay pass woh ehkaam ley ker aaye jo unn ki apni mansha kay khilaf thay to unhon ney unn ki aik jamat ki takzeeb ki aur aik jamat ko qatal kerdiya

Aur samajh bethay kay koi pakar na hogi, pus andhay behray bann bethay, phir Allah Taalaa ney unn ki tauba qabool ki, uss kay baad bhi unn mein say aksar andhay behray hogaye. Allah Taalaa unn kay aemaal ko bakhoobi dekhney wala hai

Bey shak woh log kafir hogaye jin ka qol hai kay maseeh ibn Maryam hi Allah hai halankay khud maseeh ney unn say kaha tha kay aey bani israeel! Allah hi ki ibadat kero jo mera aur tumhara sab ka rab hai, yaqeen mano kay jo shakhs Allah kay sath shareek kerta hai Allah Taalaa ney uss per jannat haram ker di hai, uss ka thikana jahannum hi hai aur gunehgaron ki madad kerney wala koi nahi hoga

Woh log bhi qata’an kafir hogaye jinhon ney kaha, Allah teen mein ka teesra hai, dar-asal siwa Allah Taalaa kay koi mabood nahi. Agar yeh log apney uss qol say baaz na rahey to unn mein say jo kufur per rahen gay, unhen alamnaak azab zaroor phonchay ga
Yeh log kiyon Allah Taalaa ki taraf nahi jhuktay aur kiyon istaghfaar nahi kertay? Allah Taalaa to boht hi bakhshney wala aur bara hi meharban hai

Maseeh ibn Maryam siwa payghumbar honey kay aur kuch bhi nahi, uss say pehlay bhi boht say payghumbar chukay hain unn ki walida aik raast baaz aurat thin dono maa betay khana khaya kertay thay, aap dekhiye kay kiss tarah hum unn kay samney daleelen rakhtay hain phir ghor kijiye kay kiss tarah woh phiray jatay hain
Aap keh dijiye kay kiya tum Allah kay siwa unn ki ibadat kertay ho jo na tumharay kissi nuksan kay malik hain na kissi nafa kay, Allah hi khoob sunnay aur poori tarah jannay wala hai

Keh dijiye aey ahl kitab! apney deen mein na-haq ghuloov aur ziyadti na kero aur unn logon ki nafsani khuwaishon ki pairwee na kero jo pehlay say behak chukay hain aur bohton ko behka bhi chukay hain aur seedhi raah say hatt gaye hain

Bani israeel kay kafiron per (hazrat) Dawood (alaihi as-salam) aur (hazrat) Isa bann Maryam (alaihi as-salam) ki zabani laanat ki gaee uss wajah say kay woh farmaniyan kertay thay aur hadd say aagay barh jatay thay
Aapas mein aik doosray ko buray kaamon say jo woh kertay thay roktay na thay jo kuch bhi yeh kertay thay yaqeenan woh boht bura tha

Unn mein say boht say logon ko aap dekhen gay kay woh kafiron say dostiyan kertay hain, jo kuch unhon ney apney liye aagay bhej rakha hai woh boht bura hai kay Allah Taalaa unn say naraz hua aur woh hamesha azab mein rahen gay
Agar unhen Allah Taalaa per aur nabi per aur jo nazil kiya gaya hai uss per eman hota to yeh kuffaar say dostiyan na kertay, lekin unn mein kay aksar log fasiq hain

Yaqeenan aap eman walon ka sab say ziyadah dushman yahudiyon aur mushrikon ko payen gay aur eman walon say sab say ziyadah dosti kay qareeb aap yaqeenan unhen payen gay jo apney aap ko nasaara kehtay hain, yeh uss liye kay unn mein ulama aur ibadat kay liye gosha nasheen fard paye jatay hain aur uss wajah say kay woh takabbur nahi kertay

Aur jab woh rasool ki taraf nazil kerdah (kalaam) ko suntay hain to aap unn ki aankhen aansoo say behti hui dekhtay hain uss sabab say kay unhon ney haq ko pehchan liya, woh kehtay hain kay aey humaray rab! hum eman ley aaye pus to hum ko bhi unn logon kay sath likh ley jo tasdeeq kertay hain

Aur humaray pass kaun sa uzur hai kay hum Allah Taalaa per aur jo haq hum ko phoncha hai uss per eman na layen aur hum uss baat ki umeed rakhtay hain kay humara rab hum ko nek logon ki rafaqat mein dakhil kerdey ga
Uss liye unn ko Allah Taalaa unn kay uss qol ki wajah say aisay baagh dey ga jin kay neechay nehren jari hun gi, yeh unn mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay aur nek logon ka yehi badla hai
Aur jin logon ney kufur kiya aur humari aayaat ko jhutlatay rahey woh log dozakh walay hain
Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa ney jo pakeezah cheezen tumharay wastay halal ki hain unn ko haram mat kero aur hadd say aagay mat niklo, be-shak Allah Taalaa hadd say nikalney walon ko pasand nahi kerta
Aur Allah Taalaa ney jo cheezen tum ko di hain unn mein say halal marghoob cheezen khao aur Allah Taalaa say daro jiss per tum eman rakhtay ho

Allah Taalaa tumhari qasmon mein laghaw qasam per tum say moaakhiza nahi farmata lekin moaakhiza uss per farmata hai kay tum jin qasmon ko mazboot kerdo. Uss ka kaffaara das mohtajon ko khana dena hai osat darjay ka jo apney ghar walon ko khilatay ho ya unn ko kapra dena ya aik ghulam ya londi aazad kerna hai aur jiss ko maqdoor na ho to teen din kay rozay hain yeh tumhari qasmon ka kaffaara hai jab kay tum qasam kha lo aur apni qasmon ka khayal rakho! ussi tarah Allah Taalaa tumharay wastay apney ehkaam biyan farmata hai takay tum shukar kero
Aey eman walo! baat yehi hai kay sharab aur juaa aur thaan aur faal nikalney kay paansay kay teer, yeh sab gandi baaten, shetani kaam hain unn say bilkul alag raho takay tum falah yaab ho
Shetan to yun chahata hai kay sharab aur juye kay zariye say tumharay aapas mein adawat aur bughz waqey kera dey aur Allah Taalaa ki yaad say aur namaz say tum ko baaz rakhay so abb bhi baaz aajao
Aur tum Allah Taalaa ki ita’at kertay raho aur rasool ki ita’at kertay raho aur ehtiyaat rakho. Agar aeyraaz kero gay to yeh jaan rakho kay humaray rasool kay zimmay sirf saaf saaf phoncha dena hai

Aisay logon per jo kay eman rakhtay hun aur nek kaam kertay hun uss cheez mein koi gunah nahi jiss ko woh khatay peetay hun jabkay woh log taqwa rakhtay hun aur eman rakhtay hun aur nek kaam kertay hun phir perhezgari kertay hun aur eman rakhtay hun phir perhezgari kertay hun aur khoob nek amal kertay hun, Allah aisay kaaron say mohabbat rakhta hai

Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa qadray shikar say tumhara imtehan keray ga jin tak tumharay hath aur tumharay naizay phonch saken gay takay Allah Taalaa maloom kerley kay kaun shakhs uss say bann dekhay darta hai so jo shakhs uss kay baad hadd say niklay ga uss kay wastay dard-naak saza hai

Aey eman walo! (wehshi) shikar ko qatal mat kero jab kay tum halat ehraam mein ho. Aur jo shakhs tum mein say uss ko jaan bojh ker qatal keray ga to uss per fidya wajib hoga jo kay masawi hoga uss janwar kay jiss ko uss ney qatal kiya hai jiss ka faisla tum mein say do moatbar shakhs ker den khuwah woh fidya khaas chopayon mein say ho jo niaz kay tor per kaaba tak phonchaya jaye aur khuwah kaffaara masakeen ko dey diya jaye aur khuwah uss kay barabar rozay rakh liye jayen takay apney kiye shamat ka maza chakhay, Allah Taalaa ney guzishat ko moaf kerdiya aur jo shakhs phir aisi hi harkat keray ga to Allah intiqam ley ga aur Allah zabardast hai intiqam lenay wala

Tumharay liye darya ka shikar pakarna aur uss ka khana halal kiya gaya hai. Tumharay faeedah kay wastay aur musafiron kay wastay aur khushki ka shikar pakarna tumharay liye haram kiya gaya hai jab tak tum halat ehraam mein raho aur Allah Taalaa say daro jiss kay pass jama kiye jao gay

Allah ney kaaba ko jo adab ka makan hai logon kay qaeem rehney ka sabab qarar dey diya aur izzat walay maheeney ko bhi aur haram mein qurbani honey walay janwar ko bhi aur unn janwaron ko bhi jin kay galay mein pattay hun yeh uss liye takay tum uss baat ka yaqeen ker lo kay be-shak Allah tamam aasmano aur zamin kay andar ki cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai aur be-shak Allah sab cheezon ko khoob janta hai
Tum yaqeen jano kay Allah Taalaa saza bhi sakht denay wala hai aur Allah Taalaa bari maghfirat aur bari rehmat wala bhi hai
Rasool kay zimmay to sirf phonchana hai. Aur Allah Taalaa sab janta hai jo kuch tum zahir kertay ho aur jo kuch posheedah rakhtay ho
Aap farma dijiye kay pak aur pak barabar nahi go aap ko pak ki kasrat bhali lagti ho Allah Taalaa say dartay raho aey aqal mando! takay tum kaamyaab ho

Aey eman walo! aisi baaten mat poocho kay agar tum per zahir ker di jayen to tumhen nagawaar hun aur agar tum zamaney nuzool Quran mein unn baaton ko poocho gay to tum per zahir kerdi jayen gi sawalaat guzishta Allah ney moaf kerdiye aur Allah bari maghfirat wala baray hilm wala hai
Aisi baaten tum say pehlay aur logon ney bhi poochi thin, phir unn baaton kay munkir hogaye
Allah Taalaa ney na bahiyyra ko mashroo kiya hai aur na saaeeba ko aur na waseela ko aur na haam ko lekin jo log kafir hain woh Allah Taalaa per jhoot lagatay hain aur aksar kafir aqal nahi rakhtay

Aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah Taalaa ney jo ehkaam nazil farmaye hain unn ki taraf aur rasool ki taraf rujoo kero to kehtay hain kay hum ko o hi kafi hai jiss per hum ney apney baron ko paya, kiya agar cheh unn kay baray na kuch samajh rakhtay hun aur na hidayat rakhtay hun

Aey eman walon! apni fikar kero, jab tum raah raast per chal rahey ho to jo shakhs gumrah rahey uss say tumhara koi nuksan nahi. Allah hi kay pass tum sab ko jana hai phir woh tum sab ko batla dey ga jo kuch tum sab kertay thay

Aey eman walo! tumharay aapas mein do shakhs ka gawah hona munasib hai jabkay tum mein say kissi ko maut aaney lagay aur wasiyat kerney ka waqt ho woh do shakhs aisay hun kay deendar hun khuwah tum mein say hun ya ghair logon mein say do shakhs hun agar tum kahen safar mein gaye ho aur tumhen maut aa jaye agar tum ko shuba)yeh ho to unn dono ko baad namaz rok lo phir dono Allah ki qasam khayen kay hum uss qasam kay ewaz koi nafa nahi lena chahatay agar cheh koi qarabat daar bhi ho aur Allah Taalaa ki baat ko hum posheedah na keren gay, hum uss halat mein sakht gunehgar hun gay

Phir agar uss ki itlaa ho kay woh dono gawah kissi gunah kay murtakib huye hain to unn logon mein say jin kay muqabla mein gunah ka irtakaab hua tha aur do shakhs jo sab mein qareeb tar hain jahan woh dono kharay huye thay yeh dono kharay hun phir dono Allah ki qasam khayen kay bil-yaqeen humari yeh qasam unn dono ki uss qasam say ziyadah raast hai aur hum ney zara tajawuz nahi kiya, hum uss halat mein sakht zalim hun gay

Yeh qareeb zariye hai uss amar ka kay woh log waqiah ko theek tor per zahir keren ya uss baat say darr jayen kay unn say qasmen lenay kay baad qasmen ulti parr jayen gi aur Allah Taalaa say daro aur suno! aur Allah Taalaa fasiq logon ko hidayat nahi kerta

Jiss roz Allah Taalaa tamam payghumbaron ko jama keray ga, phir irshad farmaye ga kay tum ko kiya jawab mila tha, woh arz keren gay kay hum ko kuch khabar nahi to hi be-shak posheedah baaton ko poora jannay wala hai

Jab kay Allah Taalaa irshad farmaye ga kay aey Isa bann Maryam! mera inam yaad kero jo tum per aur tumhari walida per hua hai, jab mein ney tum ko rooh rooh-ul-qudus say taeed di. Tum logon say kalaam kertay thay godd mein bhi aur bari umar mein bhi aur jab kay mein ney tum ko kitab aur hikmat ki baaten aur Taurat aur Injeel ki taleem di aur jab kay tum meray hukum say gaaray say aik shakal banatay thay jaisay parinda ki shakal hoti hai phir tum uss kay andar phoonk maar detay thay jiss say woh parind bann jata tha meray hukum say aur tum acha ker detay thay maadar andhay ko aur korhi ko meray hukum say aur jab kay tum mardon ko nikal ker khara ker letay thay meray hukum say aur jab kay mein ney bani israeel ko tum say baaz rakha jab tum unn kay pass daleelen ley ker aaye thay phir unn mein jo kafir thay unhon ney kaha tha kay ba-juz khulay jadoo kay yeh aur kuch bhi nahi
Aur jab kay mein ney hawareen ko hukum diya kay tum mujh per aur meray rasool per eman lao, unhon ney kaha kay hum eman laye aur aap shahid rahiye kay hum pooray farman bardaar hain

Woh waqt yaad kay qabil hai jab kay hawariyon ney arz kiya kay aey Isa bann Maryam! kiya aap ka rab aisa sakta hai kay hum per aasman say aik khuwaan) dastarkhwan (nazil farma dey? Aap ney farmaya kay Allah say daro agar tum eman walay ho

Woh bolay kay hum yeh chahatay hain kay uss mein say khayen aur humaray dilon ko poora itminan hojaye aur humara yeh yaqeen aur barh jaye kay aap ney hum say sach bola hai aur hum gawahi denay walon mein say hojayen

Isa ibn Maryam ney dua ki kay aey Allah aey humaray perwerdigar! hum per aasman say khana nazil farma! kay woh humaray liye yani hum mein jo awwal hain aur jo baad kay hain sab kay liye aik khushi ki baat hojaye aur teri taraf say aik nishani hojaye aur to hum ko rizq ata farma aur to sab ata kerney walon say acha hai

Haq Taalaa ney irshad farmaya kay mein woh khana tum logon per nazil kerney wala hun, phir jo shakhs tum mein say uss kay baad na-haq shanasi keray ga to mein uss ko aisi saza doon ga kay woh saza duniya jahaan walon mein say kissi ko na doon ga

Aur woh waqt bhi qabil zikar hai jab kay Allah Taalaa farmaye ga kay aey Isa ibn Maryam! kiya tum ney unn logon say keh diya tha kay mujh ko aur meri maa ko bhi alawa Allah kay mabood qarar dey lo! Isa arz keren gay kay mein to tujh ko munza samjhta hun, mujh ko kissi tarah zaiba na tha kay mein aisi baat kehta jiss kay kehney ka mujh ko koi haq nahi, agar mein ney kaha hoga to tujh ko uss ka ilm hoga. To, to meray dil kay andar ki baat bhi janta hai aur mein teray nafs mein jo kuch hai uss ko nahi janta. Tamam ghaibon ka jannay wala to hi hai

Mein ney to unn say aur kuch nahi kaha magar sirf o hi jo tu ney mujh say kehney ko farmaya tha kay tum Allah ki bandagi ikhtiyar kero jo mera bhi rab hai aur tumhara bhi rab hai. Mein unn per gawah raha jab tak unn mein raha. Phir jab tu ney mujh ko utha liya to, to hi unn per mutlaa raha. Aur to her cheez ki poori khabar rakhta hai
Agar to unn ko saza dey to yeh teray banday hain aur agar to unn ko moaf farma dey to, to zabardast hai hikmat wala hai

Allah irshad farmaye ga kay yeh woh din hai kay jo log sachay thay unn ka sacha hona unn kay kaam aaye ga unn ko baagh milen gay jin kay neechay nehren jari hun gi jin mein woh hamesha hamesha ko rahen gay. Allah Taalaa unn say razi aur khush aur yeh Allah say razi aur khush hain, yeh bari (bhari) kaamyabi hai
Allah hi ki hai saltanat aasmano ki aur zamin ki aur unn cheezon ki jo unn mein mojood hain aur woh her shey per poori qudrat rakhta hai
